_doc: Player bot mode (T-071; gravelight/bots/player_bot.gd + bot_trainer.gd, docs/BOT_AI.md section 10). The local human's own survivor driven by the bots' brain (BotBrain with the player-bot options below) while the player watches in first person. Toggle: the bot_mode action (F6), the pause menu, the dev console `botmode on|off`, or `--botmode` on the command line. Any real movement / fire / aim input hands control back at once.
_skill_doc: The skills.json preset the agent aims with (its own; the bots keep the Bot Skill setting).

brain._doc: BotSquad.add_player_brain options (BotBrain.options): no free kit or bonus perk (the player's own loadout), it drinks perks and shops with its own Scrip, it is revived first (0).

planner._doc: The optional strategy layer: a BotPlanner on the agent (what to buy / open next). local_ai: use the local LLM (bots.json local_ai, Ollama) when the Bot Local AI setting is on; the scripted planner is the fallback whenever Ollama isn't running, and the only planner when this is false.

turn._doc: The first-person view follows the agent's look on a damped turn, never a snap: angular speed = clamp(error x gain_per_s, max_rate_rad_s), changed at most accel_rad_s2 per second. sprint_mult while running.
turn._ff_doc: T-071 pass 3: feed-forward: the look's own turn rate (low-passed by ff_smooth per frame, capped at ff_max_rad_s) is added to error x gain, so a steady track has no lag (the plain damped turn trailed a moving target past the fire tolerance). 0 turns it off.

takeover._doc: Hand-back: any of these actions pressed, the move stick past move_dead, or the mouse moved more than mouse_px in one event (captured). After an enable the inputs held at that moment must be released first, and nothing counts for grace_s.

hud.text: BOT MODE — press %s to take over

plans._doc: T-071 pass 2: the agent's game plan per map (AgentPlan, gravelight/bots/agent_plan.gd): steps in the order a skilled solo player spends ({door}, {power}, {perk}, {gun, or_tier}, {crucible}; optional from_round); the agent's economy only buys what the current step needs (plus ammo, boards, the power switch). train_at: the loops it prefers, best first (BotTrainer adds trainer.plan_bonus / place). With every step done the ordinary economy takes over.
plans._skip_doc: T-071 pass 3: while the current step can't be done (unaffordable: the next skip_ahead steps that are cheaper may go first; affordable but waiting for its moment, e.g. a perk in the cellar mid-round: any of them). A step with firm: true is never jumped (AgentPlan.later_steps). A map's plan may set its own skip_ahead.

map00._why: Crossroads Inn solo: the Garand off the taproom wall (one-shot heads to round 4), the cellar door for the power, Second Wind (the solo self-revive) and Ironhide (5 hits), then the stable and the yard: the Well Loop is the map's open ground (measured: 2-4 hits a training minute against 10-15 on the taproom's ring round its four windows) with the Thompson chalked on the stable wall beside it (wall ammo on a lap); Marathon (an endless sprint outruns the runners from round 8), then the Thompson into the Crucible.

map01._why: Kaltenbrunn solo: the Rail Yard door and the MP40, the Administration door for Second Wind (it works without the power solo), the Barracks, then down the lift to the Chapel and into the Generator Hall to throw the Hauptschalter (the power never came on solo in pass 1: no step led there); Ironhide back in the Barracks, Marathon in the Chapel, the StG-44 in the Lab corridor.

points._doc: T-071 pass 3: Scrip in the first rounds the way a solo player makes it: up to knife_until_round, a lone zombie (nothing else within crowd_m, the agent unhurt) is shot in the body until the knife kills it, then let come and knifed (130 Scrip a knife kill; BotAim.knife_for_points). 0 turns it off.

_wall_ammo_doc: T-071 pass 3: the agent buys wall ammo for its main gun below this share of a full load (economy.json wall_ammo_below, 0.35, for the bots).

crawler._doc: T-071 pass 3: the crawler break (AgentCrawler, gravelight/bots/agent_crawler.gd). With the round down to its last zombie (nothing left to spawn, from from_round, never a special round) and an errand pending (the plan's step affordable and reachable, a Second Wind rebuy, the main gun under ammo_frac), the agent shoots its legs until it crawls (giving up after make_max_s or when the sever roll fails), then does its errands as in a break while it crawls (left out of the threat picture beyond ignore_within_m), and kills it once nothing is left to do for done_s (or after hold_max_s). Solo or with no bot teammates only.

trainer._doc: BotTrainer: training the horde round a TrainingRoute (routes_<map>.json). The train: zombies following within follow_m behind on the loop (or within close_m anywhere). Gaps (flat metres to the train's head, the nearest follower): gap = its reach (ai_counters reach_m, 1.5 by default) + gap_margin_m + head speed x gap_per_speed_s (a runner gets more room); the agent runs (faces the way) when the head is inside gap, sprints inside gap - sprint_inside_m, turns to fire once it is beyond gap + turn_extra_m with the next ahead_need_m of the loop clear, and holds still to let a far train bunch up beyond hold_extra_m. A turn lasts at most face_max_s, then a glance forward of run_min_s (it can't see ahead while it looks back: no wallhacks). A zombie on the loop ahead within cut_m is a cutter: shot when the train is at least cut_kill_gap_m behind, passed on the ring's far side when there is room (pass_min_ring_m), else the loop is reversed when the other way is clear for reverse_clear_m. Unseen zombies' remembered positions are advanced toward the agent at their speed for up to dead_reckon_s (the train follows; a person knows that).
trainer._pass2_doc: T-071 pass 2: own_from_round: from this round (and in every special round) the trainer owns the round (BotBrain runs lead_train whatever else scores, a revive excepted). Gathering: facing the way it lets the round group up behind it until gather_target() followers (gather_n, gather_by_round [[round, n]...], never more than the round has left; gather_left_out: how many may still be elsewhere once the spawns are out), then turns on the train (FACE) while safe_to_turn. rejoin_nav_m: further than this off the loop it takes the navmesh back (TRAVEL), nearer the kite steers it back on. Sprint (RUN): head inside gap + sprint_extra_m (+ sprint_runner_m for a zombie faster than a walk; sprint_marathon_m with Marathon's endless sprint). run_fire_deg: while gathering only a target within this angle of the way ahead is shot. cut_pass_m: a cutter closer than this is passed at a sprint, not shot. boxed_score: a kite score below this with the train on its heels breaks off the loop (escape).
trainer._revive_escape_doc: T-071 pass 3: after a Second Wind self-revive, break away at a sprint for this long (BotTrainer._escape) before anything else.
trainer._spray_doc: T-071 pass 3: training a train of 3+, the fire discipline's spray width (combat.json spray_width_mult) x this: hip fire on the walk into a bunched train hits what is behind the target.
